dialogs.about: 손자가 바다 그림을 그리는 옆에 앉아서

lines.en: Grandma, look! I am painting the sea.
It's beautiful. Is that watercolor or acrylic?
Watercolor. I like how the colors blend.
Your blue stroke here looks very soft.
lines.ko: 여기 파란 붓질이 아주 부드러워 보여요.

lines.en: Thank you. Do I need another layer?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 한 층 더 올려야 해요?

lines.en: Yes. Then the texture will look deeper.
lines.ko: 네. 그러면 질감이 더 깊어 보일 거예요.

lines.en: Grandpa gave me charcoal last week.
Did you use the charcoal yesterday?
No. Is charcoal a hard technique?
No. Just draw slowly and enjoy it.
Excuse me. Do you sell pastel here?
Yes, right here. Soft pastel or hard pastel?
lines.ko: 네, 바로 여기요. 부드러운 파스텔이요, 단단한 파스텔이요?

lines.en: Soft, please. I bought ink here last year.
lines.ko: 부드러운 걸로 주세요. 작년에 여기서 잉크를 샀어요.

lines.en: I remember. How was that ink?
Very good. I still use it at home.
lines.ko: 아주 좋아요. 지금도 집에서 쓰고 있어요.

lines.en: Great. Do you also need acrylic paint?
No, thank you. But I want some charcoal.
lines.ko: 아니에요, 고마워요. 그런데 목탄은 좀 사고 싶어요.

lines.en: Here. This one blends well on paper.
Thank you. I will try it this evening.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 오늘 저녁에 써 볼 거예요.

lines.en: Have a good day. Please come again.
